title: OMPI export manifest (Kubemoot reading of working spec v0.2)
$comment: Kubemoot's own schema, derived from sections 8.1 and 8.2 of the OMPI exchange-and-runtime working spec v0.2, editors' draft of 2026-10-14 (OMPI pull request #13, commit 20235eaa9f3cb27cdce9e86667aa56ac963abeae). Not an official OMPI artifact. The spec says an export SHOULD begin with a manifest; this schema requires the fields the spec lists. The values of selection come from the spec's example and its wording (complete snapshot, a selection, a full history).
